description: This file defines the 'Order' class within the OpenMRS project, representing a clinical order such as a medication, test, or procedure. It includes enums for urgency, action, and fulfiller status; properties for patient, concept, order type, status, scheduling details, and methods for status evaluation and cloning.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a clinical order with properties, enums for status, and methods to handle order lifecycle and status evaluations.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of this Order instance, copying all fields except the orderId.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Helper method to copy all property values from this instance to a target Order object.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing
methods.description: Creates a new order for discontinuing the current order, linking previousOrder and setting action to DISCONTINUE.

methods.name: cloneForRevision
methods.description: Creates a new order for revision purposes, setting previousOrder and action to REVISE.

methods.name: cloneForRevisionHelper
methods.description: Helper for cloneForRevision to copy relevant properties for revision.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Checks if the order's type matches or is a subtype of the provided OrderType.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs
methods.description: Checks if this order has the same concept as another order.

methods.name: getEffectiveStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the order schedule based on urgency.

methods.name: getEffectiveStopDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the order schedule, either dateStopped or autoExpireDate.

methods.name: isActivated
methods.description: Determines if the order was activated on or before the specified date.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the order is active as of the current or specified date, considering voided, discontinued, expired states.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the order has started by the given date, based on dateActivated or scheduledDate.

methods.name: isDiscontinued
methods.description: Determines if the order was discontinued on or before the given date.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the order expired as of the given date.

methods.name: isDiscontinuedRightNow
methods.description: Checks discontinuation status at current time.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the patient associated with the order.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Sets the patient for the order.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the order, overrides OpenmrsObject method.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the order, indicating if it is discontinued, with key fields.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the order's ID, overriding OpenmrsObject method.

methods.name: getUrgency
methods.description: Returns the urgency level of the order.

methods.name: setUrgency
methods.description: Sets the urgency level of the order.

methods.name: getOrderNumber
methods.description: Returns the order's unique number.

methods.name: getPreviousOrder
methods.description: Returns the previous order linked to this one, resolving proxies.

methods.name: setPreviousOrder
methods.description: Links this order to a previous order.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns current action associated with the order.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action to be performed on the order.

methods.name: getCareSetting
methods.description: Returns the CareSetting associated with the order.

methods.name: setCareSetting
methods.description: Assigns a CareSetting to the order.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Returns the type of order.

methods.name: setOrderType
methods.description: Sets the order type.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing
methods.description: Creates an order to discontinue the associated order.

methods.name: cloneForRevision
methods.description: Creates a revised copy of the order with proper linkage.

methods.name: cloneForRevisionHelper
methods.description: Helper to copy order properties for revision.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Checks if the order's type matches or is a subtype.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs
methods.description: Compares the concept of this order with another for equality.

methods.name: getEffectiveStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the order, based on urgency.

methods.name: getEffectiveStopDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the order schedule.

methods.name: getOrderGroup
methods.description: Returns the OrderGroup linked to this order.

methods.name: setOrderGroup
methods.description: Links an OrderGroup to this order.

methods.name: getSortWeight
methods.description: Returns the sequencing weight within a group.

methods.name: setSortWeight
methods.description: Sets the sequence weight.

methods.name: getFulfillerStatus
methods.description: Returns current status as reported by the fulfiller.

methods.name: setFulfillerStatus
methods.description: Updates the fulfiller status.

methods.name: getFulfillerComment
methods.description: Returns the comment from the fulfiller.

methods.name: setFulfillerComment
methods.description: Sets the comment from the fulfiller.

methods.name: getFormNamespaceAndPath
methods.description: Returns the namespace and path for form data.

methods.name: setFormNamespaceAndPath
methods.description: Sets the namespace and path for form data.

methods.name: getFormFieldNamespace
methods.description: Extracts namespace from stored path.

methods.name: getFormFieldPath
methods.description: Extracts form field path from stored value.

methods.name: setFormField
methods.description: Sets form namespace and path values.
